means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether a Cut Copy's local shape stood around it, in either of two variants: cutcopy, the 千鳥格子 page's (the lock's cells the flat T pointing down, as drawn or mirrored, and every cell of the window around it — the outer slot's arms row above the T with the wall beside it and the roof over the T's far end, the overhang over the outer slot (which must already stand at the first TSD), the two rows the TSD clears and the outer slot's nub cell under them — filled or empty as drawn); and uncut, harddrop's second generic type (the same flat T, the row above it, the two rows it clears, and the whole second TSD slot under them). The opportunity is a full T-spin Double for both; every hit is followed to the next T lock to see whether the second TSD fired in its slot.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts); a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. At a full TSD the two cleared rows are entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced): the T's orientation and the rows above and below them discriminate. The page's T-hole build with its Z placed after the first T-spin is not this window (the Z is the outer slot's wall and its overhang): a Cut Copy whose overhang goes in after the first TSD is no hit. The uncut window is harddrop's drawings' agreement box; shiwehi.com draws no second type. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a T lock with spin "full" clearing 2 lines, at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match: the lock's cells equal the variant's flat T under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board)

follow-up: the second-TSD slot (cutcopy: the outer slot, split by the first TSD's two cleared rows until that TSD joins it; uncut: the whole slot under the cleared rows) carried through every clear and garbage insertion to the next T lock, each step verified against the engine's next board; fired iff that T is the slot and a scored full TSD

controls, per variant: the same window at scored TSS, TST, mini TSS and mini TSD; ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)

rules: fragment: a key cell — cutcopy: the roof over the T's end, the outer slot's wall and the overhang over the outer slot (roof_cells and window_extra), which every build places; uncut: the overhang over the T's right arm (uncut.spin row 1, column 4) — the other filled cells of that row harddrop draws as plain stack — belongs to a piece not all four of whose cells are on the board before the T (a line clear cut it)
garbage_in_shape: a key cell is garbage
shape_cell_empty: a key cell is empty (the window requires it filled, so only a weakened window can admit this)
dpc: the board is empty after one of the 14 locks before the T, the T itself, or one of the 14 after it (the DPC setup)
ownership_unverified: a lock before the T has a row map the digest could not verify, so its pieces cannot be told apart

not_whole_shape: none of the source page's own drawings of the variant (its board and its agreement drawings) stands around the T cell for cell by occupancy, in either hand — each drawing read as the T, every enclosed hole touching it or within three rows under it, and a one-cell margin (technique-wholeshape.ts)
qualifies iff none applies; the shape stood at every hit either way
